## ADDENDUM (authored, at the operator's direction, 2026-09-15, after the handoff above was generated)

**This addendum supersedes the "First action" and the "Operator items" in the resume line above, and corrects the generated CC dispatch block.** Read `docs/design/2026-09-15_DN-005_reorientation_the_framework_is_the_goal.md` in full before acting on anything else in this handoff.

**What went wrong in this session, in one paragraph.** The goal of this project is and always has been the AI-readiness framework: a way to rate and score, quantitatively and qualitatively, an agency's AI readiness. L0 is the most basic level of it. Over 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-15 the Desktop ran the L0 report as a publication (citation appendix, licences on five faces, a self-row scan, DOI metadata, a page budget) and, when the operator questioned the DOI, swung to "the deliverable is the January ICSP brief." The operator rejected both as the same error: naming the most recent artifact as the goal. The research discipline built in this window stands and was worth it (Result states verified by re-derivation, every check cited to an admitted source, every re-judgement on the log, two destructive code paths found and locked). The publication track is closed.

**Standing map (DN-005 §2).** The framework object exists in the graph and is the substrate. Measurement is to be tiered per indicator: measured by our harness (Tier M, the cold data), measurable with open tools such as Screaming Frog (Tier O, investigation started, coverage unanswered), declared only (Tier D, the honest scope of a survey). The prescription layer (action → indicator, with effort, cost, value, sourced) does not exist and is the largest gap. The MCP over this graph does not exist. The scoring model and level definitions do not exist. The January ICSP artifact the working group expects is a self-report survey; this project's position is to probe the sites and treat the survey as the declared layer against measured behaviour (the A11 triad, already in the instrument).

**Order of work (DN-005 §4):** standing cadence → capability tiering of every indicator → prescription schema and first sourced actions for Tier M checks → MCP over the graph → scoring model and levels. The January view falls out of the first three.

**Operator items:** none. The DOI is not being minted. The host repository is cosmetic and waits for the operator to ask. A12 stays CANDIDATE until product-level work. Nothing on this list needs the operator before January.

**Corrected first action.** Dispatch `cc_tasks/2026-09-14_standing_guards.md` (`0af9b050`), the last task of the closed track, because it stops the evidence moving under everything else. Then update `CLAUDE.md`'s statement of purpose to cite DN-005, and author the first task under DN-005 §4 item 1 (the standing dispatcher, `6ee71737`), naming the layer it advances in its header per DN-005 §5.
